<h2>Resolve sjSDM Regularization for Final Fit</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Resolves unit-CV, tier-pooled, or no-model regularization from feasibility
status and compatible selection artifacts.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>resolve_sjsdm_regularization_for_fit(
  data_feasibility = NULL,
  data_model_context = NULL,
  data_unit_selection = NULL,
  data_tier_artifact = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_feasibility">data_feasibility</code></td>
<td>
<p>One-row feasibility table containing cv_feasibility_status.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_model_context">data_model_context</code></td>
<td>
<p>One-row table containing tier, taxonomic resolution, response family,
predictor structure, and candidate-table hash.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_unit_selection">data_unit_selection</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional one-row unit-CV candidate selection.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_tier_artifact">data_tier_artifact</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional one-row tier artifact returned by
[build_sjsdm_tier_tuning_artifact()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>One-row tibble containing model context, feasibility status, selected
candidate parameters, regularization source, source tier, and selection
status. Full-model-infeasible inputs return explicit missing parameters.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
resolve_sjsdm_regularization_for_fit(
  data_feasibility = data_feasibility,
  data_model_context = data_model_context,
  data_unit_selection = data_unit_selection
)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>
